children: Shares of Ezcorp rose after the company's revenue and earnings exceeded analyst expectations in the fiscal fourth quarter.
Shares rose 7.6% to $30.45 after-hours on Wednesday. The stock closed down 1.6% at $28.30 and had gained 46% this year through the close.
The pawn transaction provider reported a profit of $34.3 million, or 43 cents a share, compared with a profit of $26.7 million or 34 cents a share, a year earlier.
Stripping out certain one-time items, adjusted earnings were also 43 cents a share. Analysts polled by FactSet expected 42 cents a share.
Revenue grew to $447.1 million from $336.8 million a year prior. Analysts expected $427.6 million in revenue.

"We finished Fiscal 2026 with an exceptional quarter, driven by strong growth in our core pawn operating metrics across all of our geographies," Chief Executive Officer Lachie Given said. "We are excited to carry this momentum into fiscal 2027, continuing to serve our customers with passion and respect, and to enhance value for our shareholders."
